editionLabel: Passport Game Studios / Strawberry Studio 2016 English rules
firstPlayerRule: The player who most recently had a wish come true starts.
officialTieBreak: If there is a dispute, the youngest player starts.
clarifications: When playing multiple games, rotate the starting player one seat clockwise each game.
